d:
Translated to fulfill a bounty that was posted here by Drizzt78. I have to say though, after reading the previous related works and translating this story, I did become invested in the story!

I tried to keep the words in the word bubbles as much as possible, but that made the font size quite small. I hope it's legible for everyone! Also, I guess it didn't help that I tried to make the Captain's dialogue a little bit more flowery and stilted to match her more old fashioned way of speaking but I felt that was important to keep.

Translation, Cleaning, and Typesetting all done by me!

Hope you enjoy!
